454.canonical: Estimate teaching load with the 20 Percent Rule — an ordinary three-credit course taught well takes about 20 percent of a term (three contact hours plus about six hours of preparation and grading against a forty-five-hour week), adjusted up for high enrolment or frequent writing and down for a graduate assistant or fewer credits, with separate allowance for supervision and advising — and double the estimate for a course taught for the first time, since new preparations are almost always overlooked.

455.canonical: Set faculty-work expectations jointly and up front rather than leaving the trade-offs to the individual — the faculty member lists intended activities, the chair or committee weighs them against departmental needs, adjustments are negotiated with all parties present — and make the revisable agreement the basis for a year-end assessment that fosters growth of both the individual and the institution.
